name: bt3-fe-build-settings
title: Build targets stage 3 (frontend): Build Settings panel, n2build from the Electron main process, progress, log and doctor results
issue: User request, 2026-11-10: 'I would like for the engine to be able to allow the user to select a build target in the engine editor UI like windows, linux, android, ios, web, and maybe other console toolchains in the future like switch'. Design and stage table: orchestrator/proposals/build-targets-design.md. Stage 3 of section 5.
acceptance: A panel lists targets with doctor status, edits build.targets, and runs Build and Build and Run with progress and log
A build can be cancelled; a failed build keeps its log; read-only roles cannot change settings
Unit and DOM tests with a fake n2build; frontend CI green; README updated
With a remote host (Docker or SSH), the panel says builds need the project on this machine and offers no Build button, or uses the host's build (decision D1)
gate: needs the user's go; depends on bt2-project-targets-protocol
notes: Reviewer: n2build is spawned without a shell, arguments are not built from strings, no secret in logs or storage.
